post.description: Admin: gives a component to a player, regardless of the self-assign rules.

GM: records that the given players completed one of the realm's objectives (any rolled one, or the pin), and hands the realm's map to the recipients who don't hold it, in the same transaction. Repeatable: any party can complete a realm again. 400: no players, an unknown player or objective, recipients who aren't in the party, or more than one recipient for a Unique map. 409: a Unique map was just given to someone else.

get.description: A page of the catalog. sort=name|type|rarity|rank|assignable|created (default name) with desc=true to reverse; ties sort by name.

put.description: Replaces a component. Once a map uses it, its recipe fields (tier, biome, element, mob types, realm kind, floors) are locked: 409.

delete.description: Archives the component. It disappears from the catalog but stays readable for players who own it.

get.description: The words a Needle, Thread or Coating name may end with.
Players by name. search matches any part of the name (case-insensitive); limit caps the list (default and most 200).

post.description: Creates a player with the starter kit: the beginner needle, 2 threads ×3 and 2 coatings ×3.

put.description: Attunes one of the player's needles. The attuned needle supplies abilities and its boon during an adventure; any owned needle can still be used to weave.

post.description: A player adds a component to their own inventory. Allowed only when self-assign is on and the component is player-assignable.

put.description: Replaces the player's notes on an item they own.

get.description: A page of realm summaries, newest first. Filter by player, by the map they were opened from, or gm=true for GM Quick Weaves.
The completion history of the realm's map (every run woven from it), newest first, and every player who completed at least one objective there.
Every objective a GM can pin: the rolled objectives first, then the other hooks of the placed events and the realm-wide objectives.

put.description: Pins one candidate objective, by key, for this run. Stored on the realm, never on the map.

get.description: format=svg|prompt (one area; area defaults to the first) or json|md (the whole realm).

post.description: Resolves the slots without changing anything: map auto-fill, random fill, mismatch and danger, and anything that would stop the ritual.

Performs the ritual in one transaction. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: repeating a request with the same key returns the first result (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of performing it again. 400: invalid selection. 409: components not owned, or spent by a concurrent ritual (reload and retry). 422: the key was already used for a different request, or the realm can't be generated.
Resolves a Quick Weave without saving anything: chosen slots as given, empty ones picked at random within the limits.

Generates a realm from the whole catalog with no inventory checks and nothing consumed. Without a map it records a new, unowned map that can then be assigned to players. Send the ids a preview resolved to weave exactly what was previewed.
